chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 355: Han Li's Instant Kill and Foundation Establishment Tactics
chapter_meta_description: Han Li ends a tense interrogation with a lightning-fast decapitation, exploiting a critical weakness in Foundation Establishment combat meta. Then a new voice challenges him at Xin Ruyin's hideout.
og_description: Han Li decapitates two Fu Clan cultivators with a transparent thread and a feint, then arrives at Xin Ruyin's mountain—only to be challenged by an unfamiliar voice.
twitter_title: RMJI 355: Foundation Establishment assassins play by different rules.
twitter_description: Han Li proves that a well-timed flank beats a flashy spell every time. No shields, no mercy, just a thread.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-speed mobility technique that blurs the user's form, allowing them to cross large distances in seconds while remaining nearly invisible to the naked eye.
A nearly invisible, razor-sharp magic tool used for covert assassination; its lack of visible presence makes it a perfect ambush weapon.
A one-use talisman that converts a spoken message into a flame and sends it to a designated recipient; common in cultivation fiction for short-range communication.

A recurring tactical observation in RMJI: cultivators at this level rarely use full-body barriers because low-grade ones are useless against top-tier tools, and high-grade ones are too slow to cast—creating a vulnerability to speed-based flanking attacks.
A magic tool designed primarily to block or deflect attacks, often activated instantly; preferred over full-body shields by Foundation Establishment cultivators for its practicality in combat.
